name: Sunnies Run 2026
short_description: Sunnies Run 2026 is a half-marathon and multi-distance race set for October 4, 2026, at Ayala Triangle in Makati, Philippines.
ai_summary: Sunnies Run 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for October 4, 2026, at Ayala Triangle in Makati, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc., the race offers four distance options: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 1km, catering to a range of runners from serious half-marathoners to casual participants. Registration details have not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km, 1km) suit different fitness levels
Central, accessible venue at Ayala Triangle in Makati
Organized by RUNRIO Inc., an established race organizer in the Philippines
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so sign-up details are unavailable

excerpt_quotes.quote: It is the one road race in the city where the social half matters as much as the running.

research_highlights: 12,000 slots across four categories: 1K Pet Run, 5K, 10K, and a new-for-2026 21K distance, held at Ayala Triangle Gardens, Makati
Race takes place from around 2-3am, with the course run through the Makati business district while the city is still dark
Ayala Avenue and Paseo de Roxas close to traffic from the early hours, so there is effectively no parking near the start — a ride-hail drop-off on Makati Avenue is suggested
The finish area stays open afterward as a market and coffee stop, with vendor/shopping activity well after the last runner finishes
Participants must start within 15 minutes of their category's gun start or they will not be allowed to start; an ambulance sweeps the course from 7:00 AM to pick up remaining runners
research_watchouts: Registration is strictly non-refundable and non-transferable, and category changes are not permitted once registered
No wheelchairs, bikes, skates, or strollers are allowed on the race course
Parking is effectively unavailable near the start due to road closures on Ayala Avenue and Paseo de Roxas
The event has previously sold out its slots, so early registration is advised

faqs.question: When is Sunnies Run 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: Sunnies Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on October 4, 2026. The event will be held in Makati, Philippines, at the Ayala Triangle venue. This date marks the race day for all participants across the various distance categories offered by the organizers, RUNRIO Inc.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at Sunnies Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Sunnies Run 2026 offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km run, a 5km run, and a shorter 1km option. This range allows both experienced long-distance runners and casual or beginner runners to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Where is Sunnies Run 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race is held at Ayala Triangle, located in Makati, Philippines. This venue serves as the site for the event on October 4, 2026, hosting all four distance categories organized by RUNRIO Inc. for runners participating in the Sunnies Run 2026 event.

faqs.question: Is registration open for Sunnies Run 2026?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for Sunnies Run 2026 has not yet been announced. Prospective participants interested in joining the half-marathon, 10km, 5km, or 1km distances should watch for further updates from the organizer, RUNRIO Inc., regarding sign-up details and deadlines.
